label: defeated opponent
definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest, including an electoral contest; direction is winner to defeated opponent.
scope_notes: Preserves the prior defeated-opponent scope. Explicit beat, defeat, victory over, trounce or completed elimination qualifies. Playing, facing, losing, standings, trading or political criticism alone do not. Both a win and a loss across historical games can be true; mixed assignments remain flagged.

facts.reason: Giants explicitly beat and defeat Redskins and have a victory over them; losing and participation rows are mixed evidence.
Red Sox explicitly beat and defeat Yankees; standings, play and loss rows are different statements.
Devils beat and defeat Rangers and have a victory over them; other rows describe a loss or play.
Knicks have a victory over Bulls and beat them; one loss row does not negate a historical win.
Rangers defeat, beat and eliminate Devils; play and lose rows express other events.
